title: Product Specification Output
description: Structured product information extracted or generated by the AI.

description.description: All the text in the description field.

weight.description: All the text in the weight section.

dimensions.description: All the text in the dimensions section.

box_case_pack.description: All text in the box, case, and pack section.

box_code.description: Box barcode or identification code (numeric string).

pack_code.description: Pack barcode or identification code (numeric string).

case_code.description: Case barcode or identification code (numeric string).

date.description: Delivery date in YYYY-MM-DD format or the string 'TBD'.
